topic.title: How a melted candy bar beside a radar tube led to the microwave oven

title: How Did a Melted Candy Bar Invent the Microwave?
description:
How did a melted candy bar give us the microwave oven?
Percy Spencer, a Raytheon engineer, was testing a radar tube when the chocolate in his pocket melted. We build the tube in 3D and show how it heats your food.
Sources: History.com (Jan 1947).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
cta: Which invention should we take apart next? Comment
